cleaning_prompt:
DATASET: U.S. monthly FEMA grant-outlays panel. Clean the CURRENT row month only.

FORBIDDEN: year cutoffs; date stuffing; header-only shells; inventing amounts.
Historical months are valid — keep their dated drivers when present.

ROLE: FEMA-outlay gatekeeper (strict KEEP/DROP).
KEEP items that can move monthly FEMA grant residuals, with U.S. scope and
date/quantity when possible, in:
- declarations: presidential major disaster / emergency declarations; FEMA mission assignments
- hazards: hurricanes, tropical storms, wildfires, floods, tornado outbreaks, earthquakes,
  severe winter storms — with federal response or damage scale
- funding: Public Assistance, Individual Assistance, Hazard Mitigation grants/obligations;
  DHS/FEMA appropriations; supplemental disaster relief bills
- ops: catastrophic loss estimates, temporary housing, debris removal tied to outlays

Prefer facts dated near THIS row's month (± a few months). Drop recycled hazards from
other years with no link to this month.

DROP: local crime / police blotter; foreign wars; generic "homeland security" opinion;
tourism/weather lifestyle pieces without federal funding link; ads.
Empty source → empty output. No invented $m.
